# Sistrum

> NRN licensed music store: catalog, radio, vault escrow, and a global player.

- Site: https://sistrum-music-platform.vercel.app/
- Store: https://sistrum-music-platform.vercel.app/store.html
- Privacy: https://sistrum-music-platform.vercel.app/privacy.html
- Terms: https://sistrum-music-platform.vercel.app/terms.html

Demo shelves load when Supabase is unset. Publishing and accounts need VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.
